svg.aria-label: Expected completion time with restarts at cutoff tau, divided by the expected time without restarts, for lognormal run times with sigma from 0.5 to 2.5 and relaunch cost 0.5 median run times.
svg.title: Expected completion time with restarts at cutoff tau, divided by the expected time without restarts, for lognormal run times with sigma from 0.5 to 2.5 and relaunch cost 0.5 median run times.
svg.desc: Classical baseline, exact (closed form via the normal CDF). Dots: optimal cutoffs sigma 0.5: tau* 20.1, ratio 1.00; sigma 1: tau* 3.68, ratio 0.955; sigma 1.5: tau* 1.56, ratio 0.601; sigma 2: tau* 0.886, ratio 0.248; sigma 2.5: tau* 0.592, ratio 0.0752.
svg.text: restart cutoff τ, in multiples of the median run time
